reference.title: Induction of CYP1A2 by heavy coffee consumption in Serbs and Swedes.
reference.abstract: Habitual heavy coffee consumption increases CYP1A2 activity. Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons formed during roasting of coffee beans might partly be responsible for this effect. The reason for the observed lower CYP1A2 activity in Serbs as compared to Swedes remains to be investigated.
